    transcript.append({'argv': list(argv), 'cwd': str(root), 'exit_code': done.returncode,
                       'stdout': done.stdout, 'stderr': done.stderr})
    if check:
        assert done.returncode == 0, transcript[-1]
    return done

def git(root, *argv, check=True):
    return command(root, 'git', *argv, check=check).stdout.strip()

def native(root, action, queue, task, *extra, check=True):
    return command(root, 'python3', 'tools/goal_lanes.py', action, queue, task,
                   '--as', 'review-owner', *extra, check=check)

def state(root, remote, queue):
    prefix = root / Path(queue).parent / 'claims'
    return {'head': git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'),
            'index': git(root, 'diff', '--cached', '--binary'),
            'status': git(root, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all'),
            'refs': git(root, 'for-each-ref', '--format=%(refname) %(objectname)'),
            'remote_refs': git(remote, 'for-each-ref', '--format=%(refname) %(objectname)'),
            'releases': {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                         for p in sorted(prefix.glob('*.release.json'))}}

def runbook_control(reused, phase, newer):
    label = f'runbook-{reused=}-{phase=}-{newer=}'
    start = len(transcript)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='d0-independent-') as td:
        work = Path(td); local = work / 'local'; local.mkdir()
        helper_output = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(helper_output):
            book_path = fx.supervised_repo(local)
        transcript.append({'label': label, 'fixture_setup_stdout': helper_output.getvalue()})
        shutil.copyfile(REPO / 'tools/goal_lanes.py', local / 'tools/goal_lanes.py')
        stub = (local / 'tools/experiment_execution.py').read_text()
        stub = stub.replace('sys.exit(code)', '''
if code == 0:
    for name in json.loads(pathlib.Path(plan['queue']).read_text())['tasks'][0]['artifact_paths']:
        target = pathlib.Path(name)
        if not target.exists():
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text('independent synthetic supervisor artifact')
sys.exit(code)
''')
        (local / 'tools/experiment_execution.py').write_text(stub)
        git(local, 'add', 'tools'); git(local, 'commit', '-qm', 'independent native fixture source')
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(helper_output):
            fx.approve(local, book_path)
        transcript.append({'fixture_approval_stdout': helper_output.getvalue()})
        git(local, 'push', 'origin', 'fixture')
        remote = local / '.git/synthetic-origin.git'
        peer = work / 'peer'
        command(work, 'git', 'clone', '--single-branch', '--branch', 'fixture', str(remote), str(peer))
        git(peer, 'config', 'user.name', 'independent review peer')

        queue, task = plan['queue'], plan['task_id']

        def peer_race():
            if newer:
                native(peer, 'claim', queue, task, '--ttl-minutes', '60', '--publish', '--no-push',
                       '--session', 'independent-divergent-epoch1')
                native(peer, 'claim', queue, task, '--ttl-minutes', '60', '--publish', '--no-push',

                        for p in (local / Path(queue).parent / 'claims').glob('*.release.json')}
        assert data['epoch'] == data['release_expected_epoch'] == 1
        assert data['release_argv'][data['release_argv'].index('--expected-epoch') + 1] == '1'

        if newer:

            assert 'not contained' in result['failure']['detail']
            assert data['claim_identity_verified'] is True

        results.append({'label': label, 'passed': True, 'native_sha256': native_hash, 'data': data,

OUT = Path('/tmp/d0c5d4-review')

import runbook as rb

transcript = []
results = []

def command(root, *argv, check=True):
    done = subprocess.run(list(argv), cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    transcript.append({'argv': list(argv), 'cwd': str(root), 'exit_code': done.returncode,
                       'stdout': done.stdout, 'stderr': done.stderr})
    if check:
        assert done.returncode == 0, transcript[-1]
    return done

def git(root, *argv, check=True):
    return command(root, 'git', *argv, check=check).stdout.strip()

def native(root, action, queue, task, *extra, check=True):
    return command(root, 'python3', 'tools/goal_lanes.py', action, queue, task,
                   '--as', 'review-owner', *extra, check=check)

def state(root, remote, queue):
    prefix = root / Path(queue).parent / 'claims'
    return {'head': git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'),
            'index': git(root, 'diff', '--cached', '--binary'),
            'tracked_status': git(root, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=no'),
            'refs': git(root, 'for-each-ref', '--format=%(refname) %(objectname)'),
            'remote_refs': git(remote, 'for-each-ref', '--format=%(refname) %(objectname)'),
            'releases': {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                         for p in sorted(prefix.glob('*.release.json'))}}

def runbook_control(reused, phase, newer):

    start = len(transcript)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='d0-independent-') as td:
        work = Path(td); local = work / 'local'; local.mkdir()
        helper_output = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(helper_output):
            book_path = fx.supervised_repo(local)
        transcript.append({'label': label, 'fixture_setup_stdout': helper_output.getvalue()})
        shutil.copyfile(REPO / 'tools/goal_lanes.py', local / 'tools/goal_lanes.py')
        stub = (local / 'tools/experiment_execution.py').read_text()
        stub = stub.replace('sys.exit(code)', '''
if code == 0:
    for name in json.loads(pathlib.Path(plan['queue']).read_text())['tasks'][0]['artifact_paths']:
        target = pathlib.Path(name)
        if not target.exists():
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text('independent synthetic supervisor artifact')
sys.exit(code)
''')
        (local / 'tools/experiment_execution.py').write_text(stub)
        git(local, 'add', 'tools'); git(local, 'commit', '-qm', 'independent native fixture source')
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(helper_output):
            fx.approve(local, book_path)
        transcript.append({'fixture_approval_stdout': helper_output.getvalue()})
        git(local, 'push', 'origin', 'fixture')
        remote = local / '.git/synthetic-origin.git'
        peer = work / 'peer'
        command(work, 'git', 'clone', '--single-branch', '--branch', 'fixture', str(remote), str(peer))
        git(peer, 'config', 'user.name', 'independent review peer')
        git(peer, 'config', 'user.email', 'review@example.invalid')
        base = git(local, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
        book = rb.load_runbook(local, book_path)
        plan = json.loads((local / book.doc['steps'][0]['plan']).read_text())
        queue, task = plan['queue'], plan['task_id']
        native_hash = hashlib.sha256((local / 'tools/goal_lanes.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()

        def peer_race():
            if newer:
                native(peer, 'claim', queue, task, '--ttl-minutes', '60', '--publish', '--no-push',
                       '--session', 'independent-divergent-epoch1')
                native(peer, 'claim', queue, task, '--ttl-minutes', '60', '--publish', '--no-push',
                       '--force', '--session', 'independent-divergent-epoch2')
                git(peer, 'push', '--force', 'origin', 'fixture')

        if reused:

                   *(['--no-push'] if phase == 'cleanup' else []), '--session', 'independent-captured-epoch1')
            if phase == 'cleanup':
                peer_race()
        original = rb.run_process
        before = {}

        def scheduled(argv, **kwargs):
            if argv[:3] == ['python3', 'tools/goal_lanes.py', 'release']:
                before.update(state(local, remote, queue))
            result = original(argv, **kwargs)
            transcript.append({'runbook_argv': argv, 'cwd': str(kwargs['cwd']),
                               'exit_code': result[0], 'timed_out': result[1],

            if result == (0, False):
                if not reused and phase == 'cleanup' and argv[:3] == ['python3', 'tools/goal_lanes.py', 'claim']:
                    peer_race()
                if newer and phase == 'normal' and argv[:2] == ['python3', 'tools/experiment_execution.py']:
                    peer_race()
                    git(local, 'fetch', '--no-tags', 'origin',
                        'refs/heads/fixture:refs/remotes/origin/fixture')
            return result

        with patch.object(rb, 'run_process', side_effect=scheduled), patch.dict(os.environ, {'FAKE_SUPERVISOR_EXIT': '0'}):
            result = rb.Runner(book, owner='review-owner').run()
        finished = next(e for e in fx.entries(local / book.session_dir) if e['type'] == 'step_finished')
        data = finished['data']
        after = state(local, remote, queue)
        calls_path = local / 'supervisor-calls.jsonl'
        calls = len(calls_path.read_text().splitlines()) if calls_path.exists() else 0
        logs = {p.name: {'text': p.read_text(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
                for p in sorted((local / book.session_dir / 'steps').iterdir()) if p.is_file()}
        release_data = {p.name: json.loads(p.read_text())
                        for p in (local / Path(queue).parent / 'claims').glob('*.release.json')}
        assert data['epoch'] == data['release_expected_epoch'] == 1
        assert data['release_argv'][data['release_argv'].index('--expected-epoch') + 1] == '1'
        assert calls == (0 if phase == 'cleanup' else 1)
        if newer:
            assert before == after, (before, after)
            assert release_data == {}
            assert data['release_exit_code'] == 2
            assert 'expected epoch 1, current epoch is 2' in logs['S01-trials.attempt-1.release.stderr']['text']
            assert result['status'] == 'stopped'
        else:
            assert len(release_data) == 1 and next(iter(release_data.values()))['epoch'] == 1
            assert data['release_exit_code'] == 0
            assert result['status'] == ('stopped' if phase == 'cleanup' else 'completed')
        if phase == 'cleanup':
            assert 'not contained' in result['failure']['detail']
            assert data['claim_identity_verified'] is True
            assert data['claim_proof'][-1]['exit_code'] == 1
        assert rb.verify(local, local / book.session_dir) == []
        results.append({'label': label, 'passed': True, 'native_sha256': native_hash, 'data': data,
                        'result': result, 'before_release': before, 'after_release': after,
                        'supervisor_calls': calls, 'releases': release_data, 'logs': logs,

def api_cli_controls():

        root=Path(td)/'local'; root.mkdir(); remote=Path(td)/'origin.git'
        (root/'tools').mkdir(); shutil.copyfile(REPO/'tools/goal_lanes.py', root/'tools/goal_lanes.py')
        (root/'batch').mkdir()
        tasks = [f'TASK-20261021-{i:06x}' for i in range(1,8)]

        for task in tasks:

        target=tasks[0]
        native(root,'claim',queue,target,'--ttl-minutes','60','--publish','--force')
        for value in [True,False,0,-1,1.0,'1',[],{},1]:
            before=state(root,remote,queue)

                lanes.release_task(root,root/queue,target,owner='review-owner',outcome='failed',expected_epoch=value)

        assert json.loads(path.read_text())['epoch']==1
        results.append({'label':'api-match','epoch':1})
        occupied=root/'batch/claims'/f'{tasks[2]}.1.release.json'

        before=state(root,remote,queue)
